usage: xo refs [--dir=DIR] [--testdata] [--limit=N] [--json] NAME [NAME...]

Every reference to NAME in the program, the declaration marked, NAME
written as for xo def. A root's check leaves out its `testdata`
directories, as every DIR/... walk does (the answer names them, JSON
"testdata_skipped"); --testdata checks the modules under them too (the
program goldens of internal/*/testdata). Several names are answered
from one check (JSON {"results": [...]}, one answer or {"target",
"error"} each, in order; exit 1 when one has no answer). Text: the
declaration's line, then `file:line:col  context` per reference (the
source line, trimmed). --limit=N shows the first N references and
says how many there are (JSON "total").

--dir=DIR checks the program in DIR (default .; a workspace or
repository root checks the modules under it).
Output is compact text, a record a line, so grep and head cut it
(decision 0386); --json is the same answer as JSON, broken over lines
with a flat record (a reference, a symbol) on one line. Exit status: 0
with an answer, 1 for no match, 2 for a usage error.
